# Functional Requirements Document — Application

Here is the detailed Functional Requirement Document (FRD) based on the provided Business Requirement Document (BRD) "Coding Requirements" section.

The default FRD template will contain the following sections:
1. Requirement ID
2. Title
3. Description
4. Preconditions
5. Main Flow / Functional Steps


## Flow Diagram

![FRD Flow Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B[Read FRD]
    B --> C[Extract Requirement ID]
    C --> D[Extract Title]
    D --> E[Extract Description]
    E --> F[Extract Preconditions]
    F --> G[Extract Main Flow/Functional Steps]
    G --> H[End]
```
